---
title: "Grid layout"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
extensions:
  photo-gallery:
    album-files: img
    layout: grid
    gap: 5
    date-format: "MMMM D, YYYY"
    datetime-format: "MMMM D, YYYY [at] h:mm A"
---

The grid layout uses uniform square cells so that all thumbnails are the same size regardless of the source image's aspect ratio.

## 5-column grid with dot navigation

With `show-bullets: true`, the PhotoSwipe lightbox shows a dot indicator at the bottom. Click any image to see it:

```{.markdown shortcodes=false}
{{< photo-gallery img/ columns=5 show-bullets=true >}}
```

{{< photo-gallery img/ columns=5 show-bullets=true >}}

## Minimal gallery with no metadata and no download button

Use shortcode arguments to strip the gallery down for situations where you want clean presentation without any extra UI stuff. `show-exif=false` hides camera data, `show-download=false` removes the download button from the lightbox toolbar, and `transition="none"` disables the open/close animation:

```{.markdown shortcodes=false}
{{< photo-gallery img/ columns=5 show-exif=false show-date=false show-download=false show-bullets=false transition="none" id="minimal" >}}
```

{{< photo-gallery img/ columns=5 show-exif=false show-date=false show-download=false show-bullets=false transition="none" id="minimal" >}}
